title: tapirira colebrookeana
intro: Tapirira colebrookeana, commonly known as Colebrookea, is a plant species of the family Annonaceae. It is a tropical evergreen tree native to Southeast Asia. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, exhibiting various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating fever, rheumatism, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Colebrookea include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have been reported to possess antioxidant and anticancer activities.
